text:
matt: picking up evening shift. quick summary: we had a short 503 surge affecting embedding routes in eu-west ~18:14 UTC, pages fired, mitigations applied. handing off now.

pagerbot: ALERT -> 3x SEV-2 pages: embeddings-service (eu-west) 503 spike, p95 latency increase. Pager: matt. Links: https://ops.redwood/dashboards/embeddings-eu-west | https://alerts.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-042

matt: timeline in brief — 18:12 first 503s, autoscaler started spinning up pods but we saw eviction churn on the leaders, suspect kube OOM pressure + eviction cascade. by 18:20 we flipped fallback routing to dedicated-cache cluster which brought 503s down.

aisha: got it. primary for next 6h? I can take prim until 02:00 UTC if li can be secondary.

li: can do secondary until 00:00 UTC, after that jordan can cover. leaving note to on-call rota.

jordan: ack. i'll take 00:00-06:00 UTC secondary shift.

matt: current status: embeddings-service eu-west on fallback->dedicated-cache. p95 back to normal, errors ~0.2% (baseline 0.05%). customer impact: intermittent failures for ~5% of requests for a 6-minute window; we've opened a couple of support tickets flagged P2.

sara: can you paste the runbook steps you executed? i'll add to incident log.

matt: copied runbook snippet I used:
```
# eviction cascade mitigation (runbook excerpt)
1) scale down noisy jobs: kubectl scale job/batch-query --replicas=0 -n embeddings
2) cordon problematic node(s): kubectl cordon gke-eu-node-12
3) enable fallback routing: /services/router/fallback?region=eu-west&target=dedicated-cache
4) monitor kv-cache hit ratio and p95 (5m)
```

matt: also ran these commands: `kubectl get pods -n embeddings -o wide | grep Evicted` then `kubectl delete pod <evicted-pod>` and restarted the autoscaler config (patched replica target from 5->8).

devsec: side note — we captured core dump from vm gke-eu-node-12, saved to s3://ops-artifacts/eu-west/1859994322-core.tar.gz. adding to incident artifacts.

li: obs notes: CPU spiked on leader pods then kubelet reclaimed memory; KV cache miss rate doubled briefly which amplified backend load. dashboards: CPU spike 18:11-18:18, eviction events at 18:13.

matt: next steps for overnight: 1) aisha primary until 02:00 UTC, li -> secondary until midnight, jordan covers after. 2) devsec to triage core dump and confirm if kernel OOM or workload memory leak. 3) infra to test node memory pressure thresholds and adjust eviction thresholds if needed. 4) schedule canary patch to autoscaler config tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

aisha: i'll own monitoring through 02:00 — will keep alert thresholds tightened and notify if any regression. quick checklist i will follow: check p95, error-rate, kv hit ratio, node eviction count, support queue.

jordan: i've added a synthetic monitor for embeddings write path to run every 5m in eu-west and page to oncall if error-rate >0.5% sustained for 2 intervals.

matt: action items (copied to ops board):
- DEVSEC: triage core dump, ETA 6h (devsec)
- INFRA: review kube eviction thresholds, propose config (infra team)
- SRE: schedule autoscaler canary and rollback plan (sre)
- SUPPORT: contact top-10 impacted customers, P2 tickets opened (support)

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, severity=SEV-2, command_channel=#eng-oncall, runbook_ref=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eviction-recovery

matt: any coverage gaps? we have no coverage between 02:00-03:00 UTC unless someone extends. need volunteer for that hour — it's a quiet slot but if core triage takes long might need hands.

aisha: I can extend to 03:00 if devsec needs more time.

sara: i'll follow up with support comms in the AM; will prepare a short blurb for customers affected.

matt: okay handoff complete. summary line to paste into shift log: "18:12-18:20 eu-west embeddings 503 surge due to eviction cascade; fallback routing applied; p95 and errors recovered; follow-up: core dump triage, kube eviction thresholds review, autoscaler canary."

li: noted. i'll add diagnostic artifact links to the ticket.

jordan: thanks — ping here if any flapping, i'll take over on midnight handback. :white_check_mark:

matt: thanks team. leaving pagerbot watch on. :eyes:
